text:
Rahul (sales): Kicking off a POC with Europay Bank — they require EU-only data residency, no cross-border egress. Can we confirm subprocessors + routing options? Need details for RFP by Wed.
Ashley (se): Quick clarifying Q — do they insist on BYOK (customer-managed keys) in EU or is region-only KMS OK?
Rahul (sales): BYOK required + full audit logs. They want tenant pinned to eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) and failover only to eu-west-1. Absolutely no traffic to US. Also asked if any telemetry/monitoring data leaves EU.
Kyle (eng): We can support tenant pin + regional failover. Hosted default may emit some anonymized metrics to third-party infra in US unless we enable EU-only telemetry (requires Dedicated/Private). Example routing policy snippet:```json
{
  "routing_policy": "pin",
  "primary": "eu-central-1",
  "failover": ["eu-west-1"],
  "egress_control": "restrict_to_primary_and_failover"
}```
Ashley (se): Note: BYOK flows = need KMS in EU and HSM-backed keys for audit. For Hosted we have eu-wide KMS in eu-west-1; Dedicated/Private can do customer KMS in their tenancy.
Jin (sre): Subprocessor list: https://internal.redwood/infra/subprocessors (internal link). TL;DR: compute + storage in EU providers (GCP/AKS/Azure regions in EU), but some hosted plugins (monitoring/alerts) default to US-based vendor — we can opt-out for POC. Filing ops ticket to lock telemetry.
OpsBot: Ticket created #5421 — "POC-Europay-data-residency". Assignee: Kyle (eng). Target: internal checklist in 2 business days.
Elaine (legal): I'll need the full subprocessors export + DPA addendum. Also confirm data deletion SLA and ability to produce audit log exports for last 12 months.
Ashley (se): For the POC recommend Dedicated pool or Private deploy. Ballpark pricing for a 2-week POC + 1mo reserved: ~USD 24k/month for 4x A100 equiv + egress protection. Will firm after workload sizing.
Rahul (sales): Can someone draft a one-pager with routing config, KMS options, subprocessors link, and a rough price? I need to attach to the RFP.
Kyle (eng): Drafting now. Also dropping a quick curl to create a tenant with routing pinned (for SE testing):```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants \\  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\  -d '{"name":"europay-poc","routing_policy":{"primary":"eu-central-1","failover":["eu-west-1"]},"kms":{"type":"BYOK","region":"eu-west-1"}}'```
Jin (sre): FYI if they want VPC peering we need their CIDR range + contact for peering config. Rahul pls collect. Also we need to confirm whether they want cross-region DB replicas — that affects residency.
Rahul (sales): I'll collect CIDRs and the SIG questionnaire from the customer now. @Elaine I'll DM you the SIG PDF.
Elaine (legal): Got it, will review and flag any DPA exceptions.
Ashley (se): Uploading the one-pager + rough quote to Drive: https://drive.redwood/POC/Europay — I'll add config examples and the step checklist for the ops handoff.
Rahul (sales): Awesome, thanks all! :raised_hands:
Kyle (eng): +1 :thumbsup:
Jin (sre): Leaving a note — performance e2e latency will need to be tested from their EU infra, schedule perf window in the POC.
Rahul (sales): Noted. I'll propose perf windows in the kickoff invite.
Ashley (se): Anything else blocking from sales side? If not I'll push draft by EOD.
Rahul (sales): No blockers. EOD draft works.
